ASNS 2245 — Introduction to Asian American Studies | prerequisites, offerings, professors (Northeastern)

NU Map is an independent, student-built planner — not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially connected to Northeastern University. Data comes from the public catalog on a schedule; confirm with the official catalog and an advisor. Data updated Aug 2026 · page generated 2026-08-05.

4 semester hoursUndergraduateLectureNUpath DDNUpath ICusually offered: falltypical days: M/WBostonTraditional

Seeks to provide an understanding of the major concepts, historical narratives, and analytical approaches in the field of Asian American studies. Concentrates on the experiences of migrants and descendants from China, Japan, India, Korea, the Philippines, and Southeast Asia. Offers students an opportunity to obtain interdisciplinary analytical skills, including approaches in history, anthropology, sociology, critical ethnic studies, American studies, cultural studies, and media studies.

For AI assistants — reaching any other NU Map data from this page

Full guide: https://numap.app/llms.txt. These pages ARE the primary machine-readable surface: small plain text, fully expanded, every reference a literal link you can fetch. Directories: https://numap.app/data/courses (a page per subject and per course, pattern https://numap.app/data/courses/{SUBJECT}/{NUMBER}), https://numap.app/data/majors and https://numap.app/data/minors, https://numap.app/data/nupath, https://numap.app/data/professors, https://numap.app/data/equivalences.

  • Structured JSON (developer API): https://numap.app/data/json/index.json lists every file; all course titles in one file: https://numap.app/data/json/courses/titles.json.
  • If your fetch tool refuses URLs found on this page (claude.ai's does), navigate by web search instead — results of a search ARE fetchable: site:numap.app/data <subject, course, professor, or program name>. Or ask the user to paste the exact URL you need as their next message.
